set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=ef65f99420aaa00bdcfa3be3faeca210ba17c4ae; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; PKG=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; GRADLE_BIN="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"; test -x "$GRADLE_BIN"; git fetch origin main; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; git clean -fd; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; DEVICES=$(adb devices -l || true); PRESENT=$(DEVICES="$DEVICES" PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -c 'import os; from realtime_network_smoke import is_direct_usb_target; print(1 if is_direct_usb_target(os.environ.get("DEVICES", ""), "RFCT70L7E8J") else 0)'); test "$PRESENT" = 1; echo local_speech_direct_usb=true; CALL_STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); echo local_speech_call_state_before=$CALL_STATE; test "$CALL_STATE" = 0; "$GRADLE_BIN" :app:assembleDebug >/tmp/local-speech-retry-build.log 2>&1; tail -20 /tmp/local-speech-retry-build.log; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/local-speech-retry-install.log; cat /tmp/local-speech-retry-install.log; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm grant "$PKG" android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO; run_probe(){ NAME="$1"; EXTRA="$2"; REPORT_PATH="$3"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" rm -f "$REPORT_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PKG"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.DiagnosticProbeActivity" --ez "$EXTRA" true >/tmp/${NAME}-start.log; REPORT=''; for i in $(seq 1 80); do REPORT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" cat "$REPORT_PATH" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '' || true); if printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^probe_complete=true$'; then break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; echo "--- $NAME report ---"; printf '%s
' "$REPORT"; echo "--- end $NAME report ---"; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^probe_complete=true$'; }; run_probe capability run_local_speech_capability_probe files/local-speech-capability-report.txt; if printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^stt_pl_installed=true$'; then echo local_speech_pl_model_installed=true; else echo local_speech_pl_model_installed=false; run_probe download-trigger run_local_speech_pfd_loopback_probe files/local-speech-pfd-loopback-report.txt; if printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^loopback_success=true$'; then echo local_speech_pfd_loopback_green=true; CALL_STATE_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); echo local_speech_call_state_after=$CALL_STATE_AFTER; test "$CALL_STATE_AFTER" = 0; exit 0; fi; echo local_speech_waiting_for_model_download=true; sleep 120; run_probe capability-after-wait run_local_speech_capability_probe files/local-speech-capability-report.txt; if ! printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^stt_pl_installed=true$'; then echo local_speech_pl_model_still_pending=true; CALL_STATE_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); echo local_speech_call_state_after=$CALL_STATE_AFTER; test "$CALL_STATE_AFTER" = 0; exit 0; fi; echo local_speech_pl_model_installed_after_wait=true; fi; run_probe pfd-loopback run_local_speech_pfd_loopback_probe files/local-speech-pfd-loopback-report.txt; if printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^loopback_success=true$'; then echo local_speech_pfd_loopback_green=true; else echo local_speech_pfd_loopback_not_green=true; fi; CALL_STATE_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); echo local_speech_call_state_after=$CALL_STATE_AFTER; test "$CALL_STATE_AFTER" = 0; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
